actual_scope: Classify rank-q complex diagonal completions of the P112 Gram matrix, q=8..20, with every off-diagonal entry fixed; extend to deletion of at most twelve half-root lines.
scope_change_reason: The proposed decoder synthesis was narrowed to an exact rank obstruction for a different mask. This frees diagonals but fixes odd pairs, unlike the active E-graph work. It is explicitly a side result, not a replacement E-graph supplier or a mechanism breakthrough.
bottleneck_link: Complex decoding is binding. A low-rank completion theorem rules out diagonal freedom alone at eight terms and reduces a nine-term diagonal-mask candidate to one exceptional diagonal. This does not price the actual E-graph decoder or improve the completed recursive moment.
stop_rule: Stop after a uniform written rank proof, exact geometry binding, 224 singleton Q(i) minors, support counts 0..12, thirteen puncture-boundary fixtures and meaningful rejection controls; no heuristic synthesis escalation.
